presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The style stripped back: the glasses component switched off so only the face is left.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm brown for face and features.
presets.description: The background is the face in this style, so a sepia set moves it along with the mouth. Lips, tongue and throat are warmed to match, since nothing red survives a sepia treatment.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: Properly grey rather than a grey mouth on a colored face. Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: Face and features take the same hue at two lightnesses, and the mouth follows.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty skin tones instead of the four defaults.
presets.description: The style ships four skin tones as its background palette. This trades them for dusty ones, which reads less like a portrait and more like a printed icon.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: An acid face with black features.
presets.description: The other direction: colors past anything the style ships, with the linework left black so the face still reads.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together, though it does mean giving up the skin tones.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient across the face.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.description: The glasses component sits at ten percent, so a small set shows them on nobody. This puts them on everyone, which suits a demo rather than a user list.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. The style leaves a lot of face around the eyes and mouth, and cropping in buys detail back.
